title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to send messages to Amazon SNS
description: Simple pattern that publishes a message to an SNS topic every 5 minutes

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample pattern demonstrates how to send a message to an Amazon SNS topic every 5 minutes using EventBridge Scheduler and deployed using the AWS CDK for Java.

bullets.text: Working with the AWS CDK in Java

text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
